text.config.death_roulette_config.option:
The chance that some poor schmuck gets
all their hard work torn away from them.
Use Really Really Stupid Inventory Wipe Sound

Use a way worse sound for when your inventory gets wiped courtesy
of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WMWgbTpStzU 
 (Unless you have "Don't Add To Sound Registry" enabled, then 
 vanilla Minecraft's stupidest sound is used).

Set this to true if you would rather use base game sounds
and not modify the sound registry, that way, people
don't need to install death roulette to join a server using it.
